rationale: Tests recall of ICMR-NIN 2020 protein RDA value from the Macronutrients content block.
Tests understanding of which national programme addresses the nutritional needs of school-age children, covered in the Nutrition Programmes block.
Tests application of Indian BMI cut-offs for overweight from the Anthropometric Assessment block.
Tests understanding that the 0.83 g/kg/day protein RDA applies equally to vegetarian and non-vegetarian diets, from the Protein Planning block.
Tests understanding of the distinguishing clinical feature of kwashiorkor versus marasmus from the PEM content block.
Tests recall of the key clinical sign of vitamin A deficiency (Bitot's spots) from the Micronutrient Deficiency Disorders block.
Tests recall of the services provided under ICDS from the National Nutrition Programmes content block.
Tests understanding of nutritional surveillance using NFHS as a survey-based tool, from the Nutritional Surveillance Methods block.
Tests understanding that FSSAI (not PFA) is the current food safety regulatory authority in India, from the Food Hygiene and Legislation block.
Tests understanding of mass fortification vehicles in India from the Food Fortification block.
Tests application of dietary glycaemic management principles for Type 2 Diabetes from the Dietary Principles for T2DM block.
Tests understanding of sodium restriction in hypertension management from the DASH and Sodium block.
Tests understanding of colostrum's unique properties and importance from the Breast Milk Composition block.
Tests application of latch assessment skills from the Breastfeeding Holds, Latch, and Manual Expression block.
Tests recall of when complementary feeding should begin per WHO/IYCF guidelines from the 8 Dietary Diversity Food Groups block.
Tests application of age-appropriate food consistency recommendations from the Quantity, Frequency, Consistency and Food Safety block.
